name: Arugal's Folly
summary: In Silverpine, Forsaken agents seek shackles worn by Moonrage worgen. Dalar Dawnweaver studies Arugal's notes to learn how the renegade mage strengthened his unstable magic. The bindings may help the Forsaken break the worgen threat.

sections.title: A Hack's Shortcut
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver studies Arugal's recovered research with open contempt for his former peer. He says Arugal was never fit to serve Dalaran, much less wield high sorcery in the kingdom's darkest hour. Lacking talent, Arugal turned to enchanted relics and devices to strengthen and bind the worgen he summoned. Dalar needs samples of those objects to study the magic tethering the beasts.

sections.title: The Moonrage Bindings
sections.body: Moonrage worgen roam Silverpine with shackles that carry Arugal's binding enchantments. Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls prowl north and east of the Sepulcher. Their heavy metal shackles hold residual arcane energy, making them useful to Dawnweaver as he searches for a way to counter Shadowfang Keep.

faq.q: Why does Dalar Dawnweaver want worgen shackles?
faq.answer: Dalar wants the shackles to study how Arugal used enchanted objects to make up for his weak magical talent. He hopes their magic will show how Arugal commands his beasts.

faq.q: Who was Arugal before he went mad in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Arugal was a mage of Dalaran. Dalar Dawnweaver calls him a mediocre talent in the Kirin Tor, but during the Third War Arugal used forbidden summoning from beyond this world to unleash worgen against the Scourge.

faq.q: Where are the Moonrage Gluttons and Darksouls found?
faq.answer: Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls roam Silverpine Forest north and east of the Sepulcher, near old ruins and wooded trails.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken so concerned with Arugal?
faq.answer: Arugal's worgen threaten the Sepulcher and Forsaken control south of Tirisfal Glades. The Forsaken seek to break his magic and secure the northern kingdom.

faq.q: What does Dalar Dawnweaver think of Dalaran?
faq.answer: Dalar bitterly despises his former peers in Dalaran. He believes they were fools to trust Arugal with duties beyond his abilities.

faq.q: Is Arugal working with the Scourge?
faq.answer: No. Arugal summoned the worgen to defend Dalaran from the Scourge. The beasts became wild and drove him mad, and he claimed Shadowfang Keep as his own domain.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you need to secure Silverpine from feral worgen to protect Tirisfal Glades' southern border and strengthen Queen Sylvanas's domain.
As a Forsaken mage, you can recognize Dalar's harsh professional judgment: Arugal made up for poor arcane skill by channeling power through enchanted bindings.
As a member of the Horde, you need clear woods in Silverpine for safe travel along the high road from Tirisfal to lands farther south.
